name: limit_property_without_a_name
why: A property without a name must be refused, not written with the empty string as its name. `Add3("", ...)` is not an error for SOLIDWORKS: in the data sheet a row without a title appears, which nobody manages to re-read and which no title block picks up. A mute refusal would be better than that row, and a message that says what is missing is better than both.
